## v1.8.10 — Settings panels fix + screenshots

### Bugs fixed

- **Settings blank tabs** — Categories through Audit Log (and Data & Backup) showed an empty content area after the v1.8.9 settings IA changes. An extra `</div>` after the Performance panel closed the main layout early; sidebar still worked, main pane stayed blank.

### Changed

- **Screenshots** — updated hero image; README + docs homepage now include Taghawsa mobile login/dashboard, Add App, and Settings Branding shots
- Removed one-off v1.8.9 theme generator scripts from the public `scripts/` folder
- PWA cache — service worker v45

### Upgrade

```bash
./update-amud.sh
```

Hard-refresh once (Ctrl+Shift+R) after update.

**Recommended:** `v1.8.10`
